title: Jerusalem, Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, West Bank, and Palestine
summary: Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, Jerusalem and West Bank are established without qualifiers and are used directly after topics; localities wholly within Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, or West Bank are divided through them. Entities wholly inside these places are qualified by the territory or city; entities shared with Israel are unqualified. Palestine is the historic/regional heading, not the PNA territories. Palestinian National Authority is a governmental entity: valid as 651/610 subject heading but never as a geographic subdivision.
validation_rules: `Jerusalem`, `Gaza Strip`, `Golan Heights`, and `West Bank` are established without a geographic qualifier. (H 980 Background)

Assign `Gaza Strip`, `Golan Heights`, `Jerusalem`, and `West Bank` directly after topics, without interposing any larger geographic entity (e.g. not `--Israel--Jerusalem`), e.g. `Law--Gaza Strip`, `Land settlement--Golan Heights`, `City planning--Jerusalem`, `Public health--West Bank`. (H 980 sec. 1)
Localities entirely within the Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, or West Bank are divided through those headings, e.g. `Jews--Gaza Strip--Gaza`, `Pottery--West Bank--Jericho`. (H 980 sec. 1)

Qualify subject headings for features or other entities located entirely within one of these places by the territory or city, e.g. `Via Dolorosa (Jerusalem)`, `Shatti (Gaza Strip : Refugee camp)`, `Qanah River Cave (West Bank)`. (H 980 sec. 2)
Name headings for jurisdictions within these places are not qualified, e.g. `Hebron`, `Nablus`, `Gaza`. (H 980 sec. 2)

Do not qualify headings for rivers or other entities located both in Israel and one of these places, e.g. `Alexander River` (Israel and West Bank), `Besor River` (Israel and Gaza Strip). (H 980 sec. 2)

In broader term (550) references, divide the topical heading directly by the specific place(s) where the entity is located, e.g. `Castles--West Bank`; `Rivers--Gaza Strip` and `Rivers--Israel`. (H 980 sec. 2)
Use `Palestine` for the region on the eastern Mediterranean coast (ancient Canaan, the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, and in modern times all of Israel plus the disputed territories). (H 980 sec. 3)
Do not use `Palestine` for the territories transferred from Israeli to Palestinian control by 1990s agreements; use `West Bank` and/or `Gaza Strip`. (H 980 secs. 3-4)

`Palestinian National Authority` represents a governmental entity, not a geographic area: do not treat it as a geographic heading and do not assign it as a geographic subdivision after topical headings or subdivisions. (H 980 sec. 4)
Assign `Palestinian National Authority` (tagged 651) only to works about the Authority as a governmental entity. (H 980 sec. 4)

General free-floating topical or form subdivisions usable under any type of heading may be used under `Palestinian National Authority`; subdivisions normally free-floating under place names may be established under it if appropriate for a governmental entity, e.g. `--Appropriations and expenditures`, `--Officials and employees`. (H 980 sec. 4)

`Palestinian National Authority--Foreign relations` may be subdivided geographically; when so subdivided by a place, also assign `[place]--Foreign relations--Palestinian National Authority`, e.g. `Palestinian National Authority--Foreign relations--Israel` with `Israel--Foreign relations--Palestinian National Authority`. (H 980 sec. 4)
Headings with `Palestinian National Authority` in $a combined with $b or $t may be assigned as 610 subject headings (e.g. its ministries or laws). (H 980 sec. 4)
A work limited to the parts of the West Bank or Gaza Strip under Palestinian control may additionally be assigned `Palestinian National Authority`. (H 980 sec. 4)
GACs: Gaza Strip `awgz`; Golan Heights `a-sy`; Jerusalem `a-is` and/or `awba`; Palestine `a-is awgz awba`; West Bank `awba`. (H 980 sec. 5)

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: The headings Jerusalem, Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, and West Bank are established without a geographic qualifier. This instruction sheet describes subject heading practice for these places and for entities located within them, as well as usage of the headings Palestine and Palestinian National Authority.

sections.heading: 1. Geographic subdivision
sections.text:
Assign Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, Jerusalem, and West Bank directly after topics without interposing the name of any larger geographic entity. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Law $z Gaza Strip.
650 #0 $a Land settlement $z Golan Heights.
650 #0 $a City planning $z Jerusalem.
650 #0 $a Public health $z West Bank.
```

Divide localities that are entirely within the boundaries of the Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, or West Bank through those headings. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Jews $z Gaza Strip $z Gaza.
650 #0 $a Pottery $z West Bank $z Jericho.
```

sections.heading: 2. Subject headings for entities within Jerusalem, Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, and West Bank
sections.text:
Qualify subject headings for geographic features or other entities that are located entirely within one of these places by the appropriate territory or city. Examples:

```
151 ## $a Via Dolorosa (Jerusalem)
151 ## $a Shatti (Gaza Strip : Refugee camp)
151 ## $a Qanah River Cave (West Bank)
```

Note: The practice for qualifying subject headings for entities in the West Bank or Gaza Strip differs from the practice for name headings. Name headings for jurisdictions in those locations are not qualified.

Do not qualify headings for rivers or other geographic entities that are located both in Israel and one of these places. Examples:

```
151 ## $a Alexander River
[located in Israel and the West Bank]

151 ## $a Besor River
[located in Israel and the Gaza Strip]
```

Note: Name headings for jurisdictions within these places are established without qualifiers, for example, Hebron, Nablus, Gaza, etc.

When formulating 550 (broader term) fields, divide the topical heading directly by the specific place or places where the entity is located. Examples:

```
151 ## $a Mount of Olives (Jerusalem)
550 ## $w g $a Mountains $x Jerusalem

110 ## $a Herodium (West Bank)
550 ## $w g $a Castles $z West Bank

151 ## $a Besor River
550 ## $w g $a Rivers $z Gaza Strip
550 ## $w g $a Rivers $z Israel
550 ## $w g $a Wadis $z Gaza Strip
550 ## $w g $a Wadis $z Israel
```

sections.heading: 3. Palestine
sections.text:
Assign the subject heading Palestine to works about the region on the eastern coast of the Mediterranean Sea that in ancient times was called the Land of Canaan, later the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, and in modern times comprises the entire state of Israel, as well as the various disputed territories.

Do not use this heading to refer specifically to the territories that are being transferred from Israeli to Palestinian control by agreements between Israel and the Palestinian National Authority negotiated in the 1990s. Use the headings West Bank and/or Gaza Strip, as appropriate, to refer to these geographic areas.

sections.heading: 4. Palestinian National Authority
sections.text:
The heading Palestinian National Authority has been established in the name authority file. Although it is tagged 151, it represents a governmental entity, not a geographic area.

Do not treat this heading as a geographic heading. Do not assign it as a geographic subdivision after topical headings or subdivisions.

Assign this heading, tagged 651, only to works about the Palestinian National Authority as a governmental entity. General free-floating topical or form subdivisions that are usable under any type of heading may be used under this heading, if appropriate. Subdivisions that are normally free-floating under place names may be established under this heading, if they are appropriate for use under the name of a governmental entity, for example, --Appropriations and expenditures or --Officials and employees.

Note: The heading Palestinian National Authority--Foreign relations has been established and may be subdivided geographically. If further subdivided by place, an additional subject entry is made for [place]--Foreign relations subdivided topically by --Palestinian National Authority. Example:

```
651 ## $a Palestinian National Authority $x Foreign relations $z Israel.
651 ## $a Israel $x Foreign relations $x Palestinian National Authority.
```

Since the territories controlled by the Palestinian National Authority do not currently have international recognition as a "country," nor an internationally recognized name, use the headings West Bank and/or Gaza Strip, as appropriate, to refer to these geographic areas. If a work is limited in scope to those parts of the West Bank or Gaza Strip under Palestinian control, this may be brought out by assigning Palestinian National Authority as an additional heading, in accordance with the guidelines above.

Note: Headings consisting of Palestinian National Authority in the $a subfield in combination with a $b or $t subfield may also be assigned as subject headings, tagged 610. Examples:

```
610 10 $a Palestinian National Authority. $b Wiz~rat al-Tarbiyah wa-al-Ta#li-m al-#}li-.
```

(The heading above, which designates the Authority's Ministry of Education and Higher Education, may be assigned as a subject heading to a work about the Ministry.)

```
610 10 $a Palestinian National Authority. $t Q~nãn raqm bi-sha#n tashji# al-istithmar (1995).
```

(The heading above, which designates the Authority's 1995 law on the encouragement of investment, may be assigned as a subject heading to a work about the law.)

sections.heading: 5. Geographic area codes
sections.text:
Assign the following codes for these entities:

| Entity | Code |
|---|---|
| Gaza Strip | awgz |
| Golan Heights | a-sy |
| Jerusalem | a-is and/or awba, as appropriate |
| Palestine | a-is awgz awba |
| West Bank | awba |
